name: Box Plot
summary: Distribution of a metric by group from raw rows — quartile box, median, mean, whiskers, outliers and the jittered observations, with the target marked.
summary_zh: 由原始行数据计算的分组分布：四分位箱体、中位数、均值、须线、离群点与抖动散点，并标出目标公司。
description_zh: 直接传入明细行（每行一个观测值，如每家可比公司的 EV/EBITDA），组件按 group 字段分组并计算四分位数：箱体为 Q1–Q3，粗线为中位数，菱形为均值，须线默认延伸到 1.5 倍四分位距（超出部分画成空心离群点），也可改为最小/最大值。原始观测值以蜂群式抖动叠加在箱体内，悬停显示公司代码和数值；目标公司用强调色横线和标签标在所属箱体上，虚线为全体（不含目标）中位数。适合比较不同板块/区域/交易类型的估值或溢价区间。
best_for: Valuation multiples by sector or region (comps)
Transaction multiples / premiums by deal type
Showing where the target sits within its peer group's range
avoid_when: Fewer than ~4 observations per group (show the points or a table)
Audiences unfamiliar with quartiles (use a range bar / football field)

name.desc: Full name for the tooltip title (company)

target.desc: Rows where this field is true are marked as the target

orientation.desc: 'vertical' (groups along x) | 'horizontal' (groups along y, for long names)

points.desc: Overlay the raw observations (beeswarm jitter inside the box width)

overall.desc: 'median' | 'mean' | false — dashed line across all groups (target excluded)

boxWidth.desc: Box width as a share of the category band

highlight.desc: Label / name value(s) treated as the target; default uses the target channel

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the value field format)

title.desc: Value axis title (defaults to the value field title)

interactions: Hover a box for n, quartiles, whiskers, mean and the target value
Hover an observation for its label and value
Click a box or point to cross-filter by group

samples.title: Precedent transactions — EV / LTM EBITDA by sector
